$comment: Single list of every shared capability the template cannot yet consume by published version. `pnpm check:template` asserts none of these is declared as a real dependency; when one is published, add it to package.json/Cargo.toml at an exact pin, delete its stand-in, and remove the entry here.

rightkit-jobs.standIn: none (engine has no job store yet)

rightkit-db.standIn: none (add when the app owns a database)

scripts.src-tauri/tauri.conf.json plugins.update: endpoint + pubkey are placeholders; use the suite updater pubkey and the app's R2/GitHub endpoint
